reviews.x: I love this straightener! I was curious to see how this brush compared to my flat iron i have been using for years. I was in the market for a new flat iron and wanted to try this brush. It heats up quickly and straightens my hair very well.

reviews.t: Works well on men with long hair
reviews.x: Got this in hopes that I could save time in the mornings! My husband has really wavy hair and he just grew it out to do a side part hairstyle and he’s been making me straighten it every other morning. This thing was HEAVEN sent hahaha it’s saved me so much time and he thinks he’s so cool straightening it himself with a brush lol love this thing and wish I could give it 10 stars!

i feel that i was a scam victim by purchasing this product. took me 20 minutes for a tiny section of hair before i gave up and used my chi hair straightener. i can normally do my entire head of thick hair in 20 minutes with a normal hair straightener but thought this would be more convenient. returning. would not recommend this product

reviews.t: Good decent bang for your buck
reviews.x: Gf left her other one while on vacation so bought this one as a christmas gift.  She loves it.  Nice hair straightner for this price.  Will likely buy again if ever in need of another.
Mine arrived dead.  Wouldn't even power up.  Now I have to wrap it back up and ship.  Don't waste your time!!!  Buy Revlons model, it at least works.
This product is a great idea and works well but it is very hard to hold and handle while using. Its awkward in your hand.

I've never used a heated brush before but have had the inconvenience of using a straightener on waist length hair. This brush does exactly what I hoped it would, even faster and better. My son and husband use it on their thick, coarse hair with great sleek, smoothing results also. Only complaint is the hard, scratchy bristles that catch the back of your neck if you move too fast. Heats fast, doesn't burn, doesn't pull hair if brushed out first. Works on long, short, thick, fine, curly, straight,

reviews.t: It's Ok, but design flaws call for improvements
reviews.x: Although this straightener brush is good quality, it's not very ergonomic. The handle is too long, and the head of the brush is to large to properly comb all areas of the scalp effectively. The bristles also don't conform to the head shape well. For some reason they thought it was a smart idea to make the heated bristles in the middle stick out the most. Big design flaw. It straightens Ok, not great. I have wavy dark brown hair. The brush seems less effective with dry hair. Try using Aragon oil.

Do not buy this hair straightener. I bought this specifically to straighten my hair for family photos. This straightener wouldnt even turn on.30 dollars i expected it to atleast turn on.i will never buy this brand again.now i have to fix all the girls with some kind of up do At the last minute because we dont have a freakin hair straightner.there isnt even a freakin indicator light on it

I have medium-thick, medium-wild, wavy hair. This....just doesn't work. I blowdried my hair in the morning one weekend, and then in the evening I tried this, just to smooth out things out and give it a little more sheen and polish. And it just doesn't work- didn't make my hair smoother, shinier, anything. I'm happy that this worked for some folks, but it just didn't work for me.

I purchased this brush on March 4th, it worked fine until I tried to use it today. (April 13th) I plugged it in and nothing. No light, no heat, dead. Five weeks seems like way to short of a time for a product like this to last. I probably only used it 5 or 6 times since I received it. I do not have the packaging anymore or I would try to return it. Not happy.

I personally don’t recommend the product. It’s nothing what I expected it to be. I felt like it was waste of money. To make matters worse they sent a duplicate  without my consent and they want to charge me for both they can keep their chuck money but I suggest y’all don’t waste your money on this product at all I’m highly disappointed in the merchandise.

My daughter has been wanting this and she loves it! She has long think hair and spends hours straightening it. She loves how quick and easy the brush is. Best of all it came in a cute pink which makes it even better.
Didn’t work at all for my hair. The rubber ish ends just get caught and it doesn’t straighten at all.

reviews.t: A great time saver and it really does work!
reviews.x: I was very skeptical that this would work, but it did just the trick! I have untreated, shoulder length, medium body wavy hair that usually requires at least 15-20 minutes to blow dry and style straight.  I can now go from wet hair to walk out the door in under 10 minutes - about 5 minutes to dry and about 3 minutes with the heated brush to straighten and style.  I was also afraid this would 'fry' my hair and lead to lots of breakage and split ends, but that just hasn't happened.  My hairstylist

I received my hair straightening brush today. It’s a little heavier than I thought it would be but not too heavy for normal use.  The quality appears good.  The cord is very thick and appears quite durable, which I consider a plus. It’s also plenty long for normal use and I really like that.  A couple of things to note – – you have to hold the power button for three seconds to turn it on, and you will immediately see the temperature light up on the back of the brush. You can change centigrade to

reviews.t: Easiest and most effective for the price on my curly hair!!
reviews.x: My newest favorite hair straightening product. Super easy and fast styling!! A few of the red beads popped off the bristles fairly quickly (after just 2 uses), but hasn't negatively affected its effectiveness...but will make heat escape resulting in possible burning of hands if touched by passing hand across hair while styling. So use caution!  Not scalding hot while passing hand to help straighten,  as would with a flat iron (but I do use a heat glove to assist the process). I'm very impressed

I’ve used regular straighteners before and i didn’t like what they did to my hair (which is pretty straight anyways). So i rested this on my daughters wavy frizzy hair that was in a pony tail. I let it warm up which was super quick like less than a minute. I brushed her hair nicely and slowly and the kink from the pony tail came out and her hairs frizziness was cut down. Her hair looks normal and it was quick. Didn’t even need to worry about burning her. I love this brush.

reviews.t: Works on fine and thick hair
reviews.x: I bought this for my 17/year old daughter. She has long (past her shoulder blades), fine hair. It works very well on it. She tried it out on me and on her sister. I also have fine hair, about chin length. It worked well on mine, except the shorter pieces on the back. While the red tips are cool to the touch, we can’t get the shorter pieces of hair into the brush well enough to straighten them. Little sister has very thick, shoulder length hair. It worked well for her.

reviews.t: Great alternative to a flat iron!
reviews.x: I’ve used this several times on my daughter’s hair now and I’m really happy I found it. I anted to find a good alternative to a flat iron, that didn’t give so much heat straight on the hair. This handles like a normal brush and you can change your desired heat setting. My daughter thinks it’s fun for me to use her “special brush,” and she also loves the way her hair looks. I also like that it wasn’t the price as my flat iron. Great deal for a great product!

reviews.t: Such a good product. Doesn't smoke, not a fire hazard, and does what it says, really WELL!
reviews.x: I LOVED my brush & hate to give it anything less than 5 stars, I really really do. It changed my life. Made my hair manageable &nice & I love it so much. Unfortunately, the orange things started popping off very quickly, and now here I am after about 7 months and it's completely dead. 😭😭😭😭  I have to buy another one.... But I'm going to, that's how much I love it, really.

This brush is better than the flat iron, let me tell you why? The flat iron works great straightening the sides because you can work along your body on your own, but this brush works better because works 360 degrees all over your hair, just by sitting down and lowering my head and can brush my whole hair and no longer tangles and the back, a MUST HAVE.

I have a thick mane of varying textures.  My $200 flat iron at the same temperature still takes me 45 minutes to an hour to get the results I saw with this item in SEVEN MINUTES!  I'm over the moon happy with this purchase.  The only thing I personally have to pay attention to is not to hit my ears with the brush.  I used it at the highest setting.

reviews.t: So easy to use and quick straightener!!!
reviews.x: I have very thick, coarse, curly hair. I’ve always been skeptical of anything that didn’t clamp my hair down and straighten it. This straightening brush worked so fast and made my hair ridiculously smooth! I love how quickly it works! The temperature buttons were nice and easy to get the right setting for my hair type. Would definitely recommend!

I bought this to use as a beard straightener. Usually when searching for an actual beard straightener it gets really pricey using that term. However, this does exactly the same job and is much less expensive. It straightens my beard well and am satisfied with it. Very easy to use and heats up quickly. The quality of the product is good too.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush works well and straightens hair effectively, often faster than a flat iron.
A common complaint is that the product arrives dead or stops working shortly after purchase.
Several reviewers find the brush awkward and hard to hold or handle during use.
Some reviewers report it does not work on their hair type, particularly thick or wavy hair.
Some reviewers consider it good value for the price and would buy it again.
